services.title: Split systems
services.blurb: For one room or an open living area, with or without an inverter. Wall-mounted, floor-mounted or a ceiling cassette — the on-site consultation works out which suits, and which of the six brands. A wall-hung split can usually be installed within a day.

services.title: Ducted systems
services.blurb: The indoor fan coil hangs on perforated straps in the roof cavity, to cut vibration and help drainage. A zone controller gives you up to 4 or 8 zones, so each room can be controlled on its own. A larger ducted system may take two days.

services.title: Multi-split systems
services.blurb: When outdoor space is limited or ceiling ducting isn't feasible: several indoor units off just one outdoor unit. Each indoor unit is managed on its own, with its own settings, schedule and temperature.

services.title: Service and repairs
services.blurb: We service any brand, even if it wasn't our installation, and you get a written report on any service or repair. Seniors get 10% off general servicing — the service itself, not parts or repairs. After-hours service is available.

faq.q: Will you service a system you didn't install?
faq.a: Yes. We service any brand, even if it wasn't our installation. You get a written report on any service or repair, and if parts are needed we email you a written quote for your approval.

We're dealers for six major brands: Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, LG, Daikin, Actron Air and Braemar. Which one suits you depends on the room, the budget and what rebate the system attracts — come and see them in the showroom.

Contractor Licence No. 127921C; ARCTick (Air Conditioning Refrigeration CFC Purchaser) AU 16525; ARCTick Handling Licence No. L008697; and Austel Licence No. 16079. We're dealers for six major brands — Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, LG, Daikin, Actron Air and Braemar — and the sole authorised stockist for Air Clean Filters in Western Sydney.

faq.q: How long does an installation take?
faq.a: As a guide, a wall-hung split system or a small ducted unit can usually be installed within a day; a larger ducted system may take two. That depends on local weather, and it covers electrical work from the unit to the switchboard only — it excludes a power upgrade. We'll advise the estimated time on your quotation.

On a domestic installation: five years' manufacturer warranty from the installation date covering parts and the associated labour, plus five years' workmanship warranty from us. Commercial is two years manufacturer and twelve months workmanship. The workmanship warranty stays valid as long as our technicians carry out the yearly general maintenance — we send you an Annual Maintenance Letter and the call-out is at a discounted rate. Flexible ducting carries a 20-year National Air Parts warranty against manufacturing defects.

Yes. Through the NSW Energy Savings Scheme the NSW Government gives homeowners a cash rebate for installing energy-efficient air conditioners. All residential properties are eligible, with no income threshold, and LMAC is an approved supplier for the scheme in the Penrith and Blue Mountains area. The amount depends on four things: the brand, the size of the system, whether it's a new installation or a replacement, and your suburb's climate zone.

Strathdee Electrical Pty Ltd, Lic. 127921C. That covers all the electrical controls, the interconnecting wiring between the indoor and outdoor units, and the electrical sub-mains from the air conditioner to your switchboard. Andrew and Anthea own Strathdee Electrical too — a family business now in its third generation, handed down from Andrew's grandfather since 1956.

faq.q: What pipe do you run, and will I see it?
faq.a: Quality refrigeration-grade copper that complies with both the manufacturer's standards and Australian Standard AS1571, with the suction and liquid lines both insulated. Where pipe and wiring run down an outside wall they're encased in colour bonding insulation, matched as close as possible to your existing downpipe or wall colour.

faq.q: Where does the outdoor unit go?
faq.a: Next to the building, mounted on a poly slab, with about 100mm (4") of breathing space behind it. Council regulations and the Noise Pollution Act make the final location critical, so we take care with the recommendation — and the final decision is yours.

faq.q: What happens if the drain ever blocks?
faq.a: Condensate from the indoor fan coil runs out through a PVC drain into the roof gutter. As a safety measure we fit a galvanised drip tray under the fan coil that drains separately through the eaves, usually near the front entrance. If you ever see water coming out of that eaves drain, the main drain is blocked — call for service without delay to avoid possible ceiling damage.

faq.q: Can I come and see the units first?
faq.a: Please do. The showroom is at Unit 2/129 Russell St, Emu Plains, open Monday to Friday 8:30am to 4:30pm. Come in to discuss options and ask any questions you have.

faq.q: Is there a discount for seniors?
faq.a: Yes — 10% off general servicing for seniors. It applies to the service itself, not to parts or repairs.

_source.aboutText: Lower Mountains Air Conditioning are experts in what we do – after all, we have been operating since 1988. The company originally opened in Blaxland East. Since that time, it's relocated to Smith Street, Emu Plains and then again to a larger premises in Russell Street, Emu Plains where we remain today. We do however, service a wide range of locations in Sydney such as Penrith and the Blue Mountains. We are proud to be dealers of six major brands: Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, LG, Daikin, Actron Air and Braemar. And service any brand, even if it wasn't our installation. Andrew and Anthea are the owners of Strathdee Electrical, a family-owned business now in its third generation, handed down from Andrew's grandfather since 1956. Andrew is a qualified electrician and experienced refrigeration, air conditioning and electrical technician. He has extensive experience in the field, installing and servicing domestic, industrial and commercial air conditioning, refrigeration equipment and electrical work. Andrew and Anthea are responsible for the general running of the business including on-site sales and quotations. In addition to this, they also participate in servicing and trouble-shooting any technical difficulties in most brands. They are supported by a reliable, loyal and qualified team of 14 staff including tradespeople, apprentices, trade assistants and friendly office staff. Please feel welcome to come visit our showroom to discuss options and ask any questions you may have. We are based in Emu Plains, proudly provide professional air conditioner installation and servicing across South Penrith, Blaxland, Springwood, Kingswood, Glenbrook, Cranebrook, Katoomba, Glenmore Park and the Blue Mountains.

warranty: Manufacturer: The manufacturer provides a comprehensive warranty of five (5) years from the installation date, covering all parts for malfunction and associated labour. Commercial installations have a warranty period of two (2) years.

Workmanship: Lower Mountains Air Conditioning stands behind the quality of our workmanship for domestic installations, offering a warranty period of five (5) years from the installation date. The workmanship warranty is valid for commercial installations for 12 months (1 year).
Please note that the workmanship warranty remains valid only if our technicians perform yearly general maintenance on the unit.
Ductwork & Fittings: National Air Parts comes with a 20-year warranty that covers all R1.0/R1.5 flexible ducting against manufacturing defects and the breakdown of materials through natural aging.

text: Rest assured, our installation adheres to all necessary standards, comes with comprehensive insurance coverage, and includes a thorough cleanup with removal and disposal of any old systems.
Electrical work is carried out by Strathdee Electrical Pty. Ltd Lic. 127921C.

This includes the installation of all electrical controls, interconnecting wiring between the indoor and outdoor units and installation of electrical sub mains connecting the air conditioning unit to the domestic switchboard.

We use quality refrigeration-grade copper piping to comply with both the manufacturer’s standards and Australian standard AS1571. Both the suction and liquid refrigeration pipes will be insulated with industry-approved insulation.
Copper piping and electrical wiring running down external walls are encased in colour bonding insulation, where the colour is matched as close as possible to your existing down pipe or wall colour.
The indoor fan coil will be suspended by perforated straps within the roof cavity to minimise structural vibration and facilitate drainage.
The outdoor condenser will be located adjacent to the building mounted on a poly slab. We allow suitable “breathing” space of approximately 100mm (4″) behind this unit.
*Please Note: Due to varying council regulations and the Noise Pollution Act the final location of the unit is critical. Whilst all care is taken with a recommendation, the final decision is yours.

Condensate water from the indoor fan coil unit will be disposed via a PVC drain terminating in the roof gutter. As a safety measure (in the event of this drain becoming blocked) we will install a galvanised drip tray beneath the fan coil which will drain separately through the eaves. (Usually near the front entrance)
*Please Note: If water is visible through the eaves drain, it indicates that the main drain is blocked and you need to call for service without delay to avoid possible ceiling damage.
Small ducted air conditioning units OR wall-hung split systems can usually be installed within a day; larger ducted system may require two days.

N.B: The above guidelines depend upon local weather conditions and only include electrical work from the unit to the switch board (excludes power upgrade). Please refer to your individual quotation when accepting. We will advise you of estimated time required.

Upon completion of your installation, our technicians will conduct a comprehensive test and start-up procedure that will ensure your system is operating at peak performance from day one and for many days to come.

We have highly experienced and full time service team we assess any system even third party installations provide professional written report during any service/repair if parts required we provide written quote on email for your approval.
